title: App Privacy answers for App Store Connect

collected.what: The email someone signs up with: for signing in, the sign-up confirmation code and the password reset code.

The daily check-in's mood (1 to 5), shown back in the week, the month's insights and the scrapbook. Declared as Health to be safe: mood is wellbeing data. Cycle tracking is NOT here: it never leaves the phone.
The pet photos someone picks and the painted portrait made from them, in private storage only their account can reach. Photos go to Google's paid Gemini API only to paint the pet.
The garden, Sprouts, plants, the pet's level and mood, game scores: the progress that follows someone to a new phone.
What someone writes or names: the pet's name and look, the check-in note, journal entries, their own tasks and habits, a memorial note, and messages to the pet when Pet Talk is on.
The account's id, which every row carries so each person reaches only their own data.

Simple events in our own database (a task finished, a check-in, a game played, with points and scores but never the words someone writes): they count Days Together, the Cozy Run and the weekly recap (App Functionality), and the owner's retention report counts them across everyone (scripts/retention_report.sql: Analytics). No analytics company sees them.

notCollected.type: Name, Phone Number, Physical Address, Other User Contact Info
notCollected.why: The app never asks for them: only an email.
No HealthKit, steps or workouts in 1.0.
Cycle tracking stays on the phone (guarded by src/__tests__/cycleOnDevice.test.ts), so nothing about periods or pregnancy is collected.

notCollected.type: Payment Info, Credit Info, Other Financial Info, Purchase History

notCollected.why: No location permission. The servers see the connection's IP address, as every server does, and do not use it to locate anyone.

notCollected.type: Emails or Text Messages, Audio Data, Customer Support
notCollected.why: No email or SMS access, no microphone, no in-app support chat (support is by email, outside the app).
Nothing of the kind exists in the app.
No advertising identifier, no vendor identifier and no push token: reminders are scheduled on the phone.
No ads and no advertising or analytics SDKs.

notCollected.type: Crash Data, Performance Data, Other Diagnostic Data
notCollected.why: The crash screen and Diagnostics keep their log on the phone; it leaves only if the person copies it and sends it themselves. This changes when crash reporting (Sentry) is added.

notCollected.type: Environment Scanning, Hands, Head, Other Data Types
notCollected.why: None of these exist in the app.

auth.note: Supabase Auth: the email, a hashed password and the account id.

profiles.note: email, gentle streak, XP and garden level, the pet photo locator

pet.note: the pet's name, species, look, memorial note, photo and painting locators, level and mood

journal_entries.note: journal entries, kept on the phone and backed up here

tasks.note: care tasks, including the ones someone writes

garden_items.note: the garden's catalog, the same for everyone

plant_catalog.note: the plants' catalog, the same for everyone

user_events.note: the event log: kind, time, points, a check-in's mood, a game's score

daily_user_metrics.note: the daily roll-up of those events

log_event_and_rollup.note: writes user_events and the daily roll-up

complete_task.note: marks a task done and adds its points

recompute_pet_state.note: the pet's mood from recent care

delete_my_account.note: deletes the account and every row tied to it; collects nothing

pet-stylize.note: sends the chosen photos to Google's paid Gemini API, stores the painting in the private bucket, notes each request's time for the cooldown

pet-talk.note: Pet Talk (off in 1.0): the message and a short summary of the moment go to OpenAI

pet-chat.note: the older pet chat (not deployed); same data as pet-talk

pets.note: private: photos and paintings, reached through short-lived signed links

updateWhen: Crash reporting (Sentry) is wired in: add Diagnostics > Crash Data (and Performance Data if tracing is on), purpose App Functionality; linked only if the user id is attached.
Luna Club (RevenueCat) ships: add Purchases > Purchase History, purpose App Functionality; RevenueCat's app user id is the same User ID.
Health steps or sleep arrive: add Health & Fitness > Fitness (and Health for sleep).
Sign in with Apple or Google arrives: still Email Address and User ID; add Name only if the app asks for the person's name.
Anything starts sending data to a new company, or a new table, function or bucket holds people's data: src/__tests__/appPrivacy.test.ts fails until this file says what it holds.
